title: Parity
summary: Classification of integers by their remainder modulo 2.

context.note: Revision 2 exposes a QEVA foundation dependency instead of stopping only at a textual framework label.

content.plain: Every integer belongs to one of two classes: even or odd.
content.exact: For n in Z: n is even iff there exists k in Z with n=2k. n is odd iff there exists k in Z with n=2k+1.
content.example: 18 is even because 18=2·9. 19 is odd because 19=2·9+1.
content.caveat: Parity here is the modulo-two classification of integers; it does not make every two-state distinction an arithmetic parity.

relations.note: Parity classes arise from congruence modulo 2.
